mechanism: Loads HTF OHLC, binary-maps each LTF bar to its parent HTF candle, and on HTF signal-candle close detects CRT: prior range candle defines dealing range (H–L liquidity) and body; signal candle sweeps beyond range high/low then closes back inside with small body and offset filters. Plots HTF range rectangle, entry/TP/SL from range extremes—non-repainting liquidity-zone and stop-sweep sensor.

mechanism: For lookback L, avgBody=mean(|C−O|); each bar contributes dir×(body/avgBody) with dir∈{+1,−1,0}; rawSum normalized to a bounded oscillator then EMA-smoothed (alpha=2/(smooth+1)). Measures directional participation effort relative to current volatility of bodies, not close-in-range like RSI.

mechanism: From distance matrix, CTDARips enumerates vertices/edges/triangles with filtration=0 / pairwise d / max edge; sorts by (filtration, dim); CTDABoundary builds sparse Z/2 face columns. As ε grows, components merge and loops birth/die—scale-parametrized complex that makes topological regime features computable. Cap maxDim≤2 for H0/H1.
